subject: RapidCare: post-call qualification — hosting preference & audit timeline
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@rapidcare.ai>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@rapidcare.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RapidCare: post-call qualification — hosting preference & audit timeline

Hi Dana / Tom — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on during the call so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- POC: RapidCare wants to run a small pilot with PHI to validate latency and accuracy on your typical documents.
- Production preference: team is leaning toward Private VPC/on-prem for PHI but may consider Dedicated reserved capacity for a staged rollout.
- Compliance needs: BAA is required; SOC 2 Type II evidence and a list of technical controls are requested by your audit team.

Action items / clarifying questions for you
1) Confirm desired production mode (Private VPC vs Dedicated) or whether you want us to propose a recommended path based on the POC results.
2) Can your procurement team sign a standard BAA? I attached our BAA-template.docx for review.
3) For SOC 2, please confirm if the audit team needs the full report or only the sections covering hosting/infrastructure and access controls. We attached our latest SOC2-Redwood-Report-2027.pdf.
4) Timeline: do you have target dates for POC kickoff and production cutover? This helps us size autoscale and reserved capacity if you choose Dedicated.
5) Who from your security/infra should our platform engineers coordinate with for networking and firewall requirements (VPC peering, allowed egress, HSM/KMS questions)?

Attachments: Hosted_vs_Dedicated_vs_Private_one-pager.pdf, BAA-template.docx, SOC2-Redwood-Report-2027.pdf

Proposed next step
- If helpful, we can send a short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines the POC scope, required evidence, timelines and a draft capacity estimate. I can circulate that by EOD tomorrow if you’d like.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0164
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@rapidcare.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@rapidcare.ai>, Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@rapidcare.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RapidCare: post-call qualification — hosting preference & audit timeline

Logan — great call, thanks. Quick answers below: 

1) Production preference: our security lead prefers Private VPC for any PHI workloads long-term. For the POC we want to run on Dedicated (reserved) so we can simulate production load without having to expose internal networks until we sign the BAA.
2) BAA: procurement is ready to review. Please send the editable BAA (docx) and we’ll loop legal. Doc you attached is fine as a starting point.
3) SOC2: audit wants the full SOC 2 Type II report but specifically flagged the sections on network controls, encryption-at-rest, key management (KMS/HSM), and access control logs.
4) Timeline: we’d like to kick off POC the week of June 10 and target a production decision by end of July. Can you confirm capacity estimates and a cost delta between Dedicated and Private?
5) Internal contacts: please coordinate with our infra lead Tom Bennett (cc’d) and Sarah Mills from procurement for contract/BAA stuff. Our security engineer (cc’d) may request additional evidence after reviewing your SOC2.

Also: for Private VPC we’ll need a short checklist of the infra items you require (CIDR ranges, allowed endpoints, certs, VPN/peering options). Can your platform team share that?

Thanks — Dana
Dana Lopez
Director of Clinical AI | RapidCare Health
Dana.Lopez@rapidcare.ai | +1 (617) 555-2024
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: RapidCare: post-call qualification — hosting preference & audit timeline

Forwarding RapidCare thread — they want Dedicated for POC, Private VPC for production, full SOC2 Type II requested (network/KMS/ACL sections), POC kickoff target week of Jun 10 and production decision by end of Jul.

Notes / suggested internal owners: 
- Marissa: lead on MAP + pricing delta (Dedicated vs Private). Need a clear delta and a short paragraph describing support required for Private deployment (onboarding hours, network runbook, HSM options).
- Vivek: can you pull the latest SOC2 Type II and extract the sections RapidCare asks for (network, KMS, access logs)? Redact where needed but we should provide a concise packet.
- Aditya: can platform produce the Private VPC checklist (CIDR, peering, NAT, egress rules, certs required) and an estimate of POC infra sizing for the POC (3 v100-equivalent GPUs for baseline)?

I’ll draft the MAP/proposal and send external by tomorrow EOD.

On Wed, May 23, 2028 at 09:12 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Hi Dana / Tom — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on during the call so we can keep momentum:
> ... (original message attached)

—
Logan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@rapidcare.ai>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@rapidcare.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RapidCare: post-call qualification — hosting preference & audit timeline

Dana / Tom — thanks for the clarity. Attached is a short MAP and an items checklist that aligns to the dates you requested. High level: 

Proposed MAP (summary)
- POC kickoff: Jun 10 — Redwood provides Dedicated pool for POC (3x vGPU baseline), 4-week test window.
- Evidence deliverables (by Jun 7): SOC2 packet (network/KMS/ACL extracts), BAA draft for legal.
- POC deliverables (by Jul 12): performance report, recommended host for production, cost delta table.
- Production decision target: Jul 31 — if select Private VPC, Redwood will run a staging validation week and schedule onboarding work (2 weeks) to configure peering, HSM/KMS integration and audit logs.

Attachments sent: MAP_RapidCare_v1.xlsx (MAP + cost delta), Hosted_vs_Dedicated_vs_Private_one-pager.pdf, BAA-template.docx

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/rapidcare/RC-2028-0417
DocuSign (BAA for signature): https://www.docusign.com/rc/BAA-sign-rc-2028

Immediate asks from RapidCare to unblock POC
- Confirm POC start week (Jun 10 OK?)
- Confirm who will sign the BAA and whether they need an editable copy (we attached docx)
- Point person for infra coordination (Tom?) to get the Private VPC checklist answered

If you confirm the kickoff we’ll book the Dedicated pool and schedule a short onboarding call between our platform engineer and Tom to go over network items.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (650) 555-3301
